Container.Name: signal-media-relay
Container.Overview: Announces new movies and episodes from Sonarr/Radarr (or Jellyfin) in a Signal group. Optional: members can request movies/shows with !request, !release, !releases and !grab. Needs the container bbernhard/signal-cli-rest-api (MODE=json-rpc). Network: the private network signal-net (create it once with: docker network create signal-net), shared only with the signal-api container. Radarr/Sonarr behind gluetun are reached via http://UNRAID-IP:7878 / :8989. Fixed version tag – update deliberately (see CHANGELOG).
Container.Requires: bbernhard/signal-cli-rest-api named signal-api, MODE=json-rpc, on the private network signal-net.

Config.Name: Webhook port
Config.Description: Port for the webhooks from Sonarr/Radarr/Jellyfin. Not needed inside the same Docker network (http://signal-media-relay:8090). Never expose it unprotected to the internet.

Config.Name: Signal API URL
Config.Description: URL of signal-cli-rest-api. In the same Docker network: http://<container name>:8080

Config.Name: Signal number (bot)
Config.Description: Phone number of the bot account, e.g. +4900000000000

Config.Name: Recipient (group ID)
Config.Description: Group ID (starts with group., see GET /v1/groups/<number>) or a phone number

Config.Name: Bot language
Config.Description: Language of the bot messages in Signal: en or de

Config.Name: Relay token
Config.Description: Secret token, at least 16 characters. In Sonarr/Radarr as the webhook password, in Jellyfin as header X-Relay-Token. Generate: python -c "import secrets;print(secrets.token_urlsafe(24))"

Config.Name: Post test events
Config.Description: Post the Test button in Sonarr/Radarr/Jellyfin as a message into the group (true/false)

Config.Name: Announce upgrades
Config.Description: Also announce quality upgrades (true/false)

Config.Name: Quiet time (s)
Config.Description: Post a show/movie only after this many seconds without a new episode of it

Config.Name: Wait for the download queue
Config.Description: Announce a show/movie only when Sonarr/Radarr has nothing left for it in the download queue – one message per show instead of several (needs Radarr/Sonarr URL + API key)

Config.Name: Max. wait for the queue (s)
Config.Description: Announce anyway after this many seconds, even if something is still downloading (21600 = 6 h)

Config.Name: Queue re-check (s)
Config.Description: How often to ask Sonarr/Radarr again while waiting

Config.Name: Duplicate protection (h)
Config.Description: Don't post the same title twice within this time (0 = off)

Config.Name: Max. episodes per message
Config.Description: This many episodes are listed individually

Config.Name: Max. description length
Config.Description: Movie descriptions are shortened after this

Config.Name: Send posters
Config.Description: Attach posters as images (true/false)

Config.Name: Allowed poster hosts
Config.Description: Only load posters from these hosts (SSRF protection). JELLYFIN_URL is allowed automatically.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Optional, for posters/descriptions with the Jellyfin source, e.g. http://jellyfin:8096

Config.Name: Jellyfin API key
Config.Description: Jellyfin: Dashboard -> API Keys

Config.Name: Enable !request
Config.Description: Allow requests from the Signal group to Radarr/Sonarr (true/false)

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: Radarr behind gluetun: http://UNRAID-IP:7878 (the port gluetun publishes). With a URL base e.g. http://UNRAID-IP:7878/radarr

Config.Name: Radarr API key
Config.Description: Radarr: Settings -> General -> Security

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: Sonarr behind gluetun: http://UNRAID-IP:8989 (the port gluetun publishes)

Config.Name: Sonarr API key
Config.Description: Sonarr: Settings -> General -> Security

Config.Name: Admins
Config.Description: Comma-separated numbers/UUIDs (get yours with !id): may grab releases the profile rejects, no daily limit

Config.Name: Requests per day
Config.Description: Titles per person and 24 h (0 = unlimited)

Config.Name: Requests via direct message
Config.Description: Accept direct messages from group members – needed if only admins may write in the group (true/false)

Config.Name: Only these senders
Config.Description: Comma-separated numbers/UUIDs; empty = all group members

Config.Name: Radarr quality profile
Config.Description: Name or ID; empty = first profile

Config.Name: Radarr root folder
Config.Description: Path as in Radarr; empty = first root folder

Config.Name: Radarr availability
Config.Description: When to start searching: announced, inCinemas, released

Config.Name: Sonarr quality profile
Config.Description: Name or ID; empty = first profile

Config.Name: Sonarr root folder
Config.Description: Path as in Sonarr; empty = first root folder

Config.Name: Sonarr monitor (fallback)
Config.Description: Only if a show has no known seasons: all, future, missing, firstSeason, lastSeason, pilot

Config.Name: Releases in !releases
Config.Description: How many releases !releases shows

Config.Name: Indexer timeout (s)
Config.Description: How long to wait for the indexer search

Config.Name: Commands per minute
Config.Description: Spam brake per person

Config.Name: Signal retry interval (s)
Config.Description: If Signal is unreachable, retry messages every N seconds

Config.Name: Signal retry window (s)
Config.Description: Give up on a message after this many seconds of Signal being unreachable

Config.Name: Health grace (s)
Config.Description: The container turns unhealthy after this long without Signal or the Signal receiver

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR (DEBUG logs incoming payloads, token redacted)

Config.Name: Listen port (internal)
Config.Description: Internal port – only change it if the container port above is changed as well

Config.Name: Listen host (internal)
Config.Description: Internal bind address

Config.Name: Allow without token
Config.Description: TESTING ONLY: accept webhooks without a token
